task_context.problem_statement: There are 200 more red apples than green apples in a grocery store. A truck arrives and delivers another 340 green apples. If there were originally 32 green apples, how many more green apples than red apples are there in the store now?
task_context.reference_solution:
There are 200 + 32 = <<200+32=232>>232 red apples.
After the delivery there are 340 + 32 = <<340+32=372>>372 green apples
There are now 372 - 232 = <<372-232=140>>140 more green apples than red apples now.
#### 140
